trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Jose: Sand in your eyes already? It only gets worse from here. Let me toughen you up for it!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Jose: You'll manage the storm. It's me that needs toughening.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Moira: My Pokémon were raised in this sandstorm. They can't see you. They don't need to!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Moira: You saw us coming all the same.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Kyler: The desert looks empty until you kneel down and look. Then it's all eyes!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Kyler: And every one of those eyes watched me lose.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Krista: Kyler counts the Pokémon. I count the trainers who stray off the path. That's one!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Krista: One trainer, quite able to look after themselves. Noted.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Keegan: Under this sand a dragon is waiting to hatch out of an ant-lion. Mine are nearly there!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Keegan: Nearly. Back under the sand with us.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Corbin: I felt your footsteps through the sand a long way off. I have been ready for some time.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Corbin: Being ready, I find, is not the same as being right.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Meagan: Guess what I brought to a desert? A snowstorm! Nobody ever sees it coming!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Meagan: You didn't so much as shiver.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Davon: Hah! You never saw me! I've been lying under this sand since breakfast!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Davon: Beaten... and I've sand in my ears.
